params.1273: Complete a Slayer assignment to improve your monster slaying abilities.
params.1274: You need spiked gauntlets to kill a gelatinous abomination. Slayer Masters and Jacqeuline Manslaughter sell these.
params.1276: Defeat enough abominations in the enchanted cave to complete your assignment.
params.1277: You can also complete a higher level slayer assignment or challenge instead.
params.2225: You gain Slayer XP by killing the specific monsters you have been assigned to. Once your assignment is complete, you can get another one by speaking to the Slayer master.
